(L. Ciobanu, B. Fine, G. Rosenberger). Suppose that G is a non-cyclic resid-
ually finite group in which every subgroup of finite index (including the group itself)
is defined by a single defining relation, while all infinite index subgroups are free. Is
it true that G is either free or isomorphic to the fundamental group of a compact
surface?
    See Archive 7.36 for a negative solution of a similar question without the assump-
tion on infinite index subgroups.                                              D. Kielak
  ∗ Yes, it is true (H. Wilton, Preprint, 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.02121).
